meta.policy: Assumptions are taken literally from each miner dossier's source_provenance and quoted source sentences. DECLARED = the cited source writes it. DERIVED = follows from DECLARED predicates in the same dossier (class B). NOT_DECLARED = verifier-needed or folklore, not written by the source. Physical folklore T>0, broadening>0, energies real is NOT_DECLARED unless the provenance quote already states it. Guo is not admitted. Skeptic negatives are controls only. This file does not admit DEV/TEST.
